body:
selfhost/emit.prn now correctly boxes an I32-typed bare-symbol payload (e.g. (Some n) where n is an I32 param) instead of silently passing a raw int where the runtime expects a real pointer -- a genuine, confirmed -Werror=int-conversion compile failure found via direct probe. Fixed via the same narrow special-case strategy as struct-return-type/struct-literal work: checks only whether the payload names one of the enclosing defn's own I32-typed params, dispatched before the general (broken-for-this-shape) path. 6 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check and a regression guard proving String-typed payloads are unchanged. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 40c212e.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: I32-typed bare-symbol Ok/Err/Some payload support
